candidates.summary: This is the second course of a four-course series for cloud architects and engineers with existing AWS knowledge. It aims to compare Google Cloud and AWS solutions and guide professionals on their use. This course focuses on compute resources and load balancing in Google Cloud.

candidates.title: Google Cloud VMware Engine
candidates.summary: Unlock the potential of Google Cloud VMware Engine with this introductory course designed to provide a high-level overview of its multifaceted capabilities. Spread across three lessons, this course delves into the foundational concepts of virtualization, cloud computing, and the specifics of Google Cloud VMware Engine.
